# LuxAlgo Market Trackerssets

> Free, CC0-licensed daily dumps of the public record of US markets: congressional
> trades, insider filings, 13F holdings, government contracts and grants, lobbying,
> short-sale volume, committee assignments, federal bills, campaign finance, patents,
> clinical trials, FDA drug approvals, futures positioning, congressional hearing
> transcripts, Federal Reserve communications, and Wikipedia pageviews
> for major tickers. Normalized JSON with Parquet siblings, republished daily by CI
> from the pipeline at https://github.com/LuxAlgo/market-trackers. Every row carries a
> `provenance` object with a deep link to the primary-source document it was parsed
> from. Data only — no signals, scores, or predictions.

## How to read this repository

- `manifest.json` at the repo root is the machine-readable index: every dataset's
  directory, row count, snapshot shard list, freshness, and per-source health,
  plus the schema version. Start there.
- Each dataset directory follows one shape: `<YYYY>/<YYYY-MM-DD>.json` daily
  deltas (rows ingested that UTC day), `latest.json` (newest delta at a stable
  URL), `snapshot-<YYYY>.json.gz` year shards by event date, `snapshot.json.gz`
  (whole dataset, only when small enough), and `feed.xml` (RSS of the newest
  rows). Parquet siblings sit next to every snapshot.
- Per-entity RSS lives at `<dataset-dir>/feeds/by-ticker/<TICKER>.xml` and, for
  congressional trades, `feeds/by-member/<bioguideId>.xml`.
- Deep-history archives too large for the working tree are attached to this
  repository's GitHub Releases as `archive-<source>-<from>-<to>` tags, sharded
  by event year; restore them with `market-trackers import` from the pipeline repo.
- Every file is a plain JSON array on one line; every row validates against the
  zod schemas in the pipeline repo (`packages/core/src/schema/`), and amount
  ranges from disclosure forms are preserved as ranges, never point-estimated.

## Query it as an agent

- The pipeline repo ships an MCP server (`@luxalgo/market-trackers-mcp`) exposing these
  datasets as typed tools over any store built from this data — the intended
  interface for AI agents. See https://github.com/LuxAlgo/market-trackers#readme.
- For SQL, load the Parquet files directly (e.g. DuckDB over HTTPS) or rebuild a
  SQLite/Postgres store from the dumps with `market-trackers import`.

## Files

- [manifest.json](manifest.json): index of every dataset, row counts, health
- [README.md](README.md): human-facing overview and dataset directory table
- [explorer/index.html](explorer/index.html): self-contained browser UI over the data
- [LICENSE](LICENSE): CC0-1.0 — no attribution required
